author: China Insights
description:
How did an actress with no professional hosting experience suddenly become the face of China's most politically important television event?

Following the investigation of former senior propaganda official Cai Fuchao, long-forgotten questions about actress Tong Liya's extraordinary rise have resurfaced. Her unexpected appearance as one of the main hosts of the 2020 CCTV Spring Festival Gala shocked audiences across China and sparked years of speculation about powerful political backing behind the scenes.

In this episode, we examine Tong Liya's journey from a young dancer from Xinjiang to one of the Chinese Communist Party's most prominent cultural figures. We explore her rapid rise through China's state media system, the political structure behind the CCTV Spring Festival Gala, the long-running rumors surrounding senior propaganda officials, and why this story continues to attract attention years later.

title: China's Biggest TV Mystery: Who Put Tong Liya at the Center of the CCP's Most Powerful Stage?
